name: projetex-fortnox-connector
description: Connector to bill Projetex projects in Fortnox

scripts.build:win: npm run build && pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --compress GZip --output ./build/projetex-fortnox-win.exe
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && pkg . --targets node18-linux-x64 --compress GZip --output ./build/projetex-fortnox-linux
scripts.build:macos: npm run build && pkg . --targets node18-macos-x64 --compress GZip --output ./build/projetex-fortnox-macos
